what: When you hover a line in a centered big-text list, two vertical 3:4 photos hidden at both sides of the line (25vw outward from the screen center) float up at a random tilt of −10~10°, from 10~20% below to −20~10% in .5s power2.out. The left one is .1s late and the right one comes .2s after that. On leave they rewind the same path at double speed and vanish. Alternating the width per line between 20 and 25vmin makes it look like the original
use: Your list name here

from.where: index.html .trip-alt trip type list — original tripListings--alternate .5s power2.out · rewind timeScale 2

note: The photo is placed relative to the row, so the list must sit at the center of the screen for the photo to appear on both sides. On devices without hover (hover: none) the photo is not shown
